offering_description.value: Designs and sells contemporary luxury apparel and accessories for women and men under the Vince brand. Products are made by third-party manufacturers and sold to department and specialty stores, and directly to consumers through own stores and e-commerce.

primary_products.value: women's apparel; men's apparel; cashmere knitwear; handbags and accessories; footwear

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying through own stores and e-commerce; B2B: department stores and specialty retailers buying wholesale

end_markets.value: premium and luxury fashion apparel; accessories

revenue_model.value: product sales: wholesale sales of apparel to department and specialty stores; product sales: direct-to-consumer sales via retail stores and e-commerce; licensing or royalties: brand licensing for categories such as footwear and fragrance
revenue_model.category: product sales; product sales; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets apparel made by third-party contract manufacturers, sold to retailers and consumers; retailer: operates own branded stores and e-commerce sites selling to consumers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with international wholesale and licensing partners in Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: women's and men's apparel, knitwear and accessories under one brand

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: department stores and specialty retailers; own locations: company-operated branded retail stores; online: brand e-commerce website

regulatory_exposure.value: low: General consumer product, textile labeling, customs and import trade rules

notes: Vince was reported to be acquired by Authentic Brands Group; current ownership status uncertain.
